validation.0.1.5-rc.2: 36 offline tests against the published host packages: the key ring (add/select/disable/rotate/enable/remove and a hand-edited record), balance parsing and host fallback with a fake fetch, failure classification against the gateway's real Chinese wording (including that a raw 403 quota message must not read as auth), the catalog contract (protocol, base URL, and vendor effort levels per model), the stream guard (terminal events, pre-chunk throws, and that a mid-stream failure never blames a key), and the real PiAiAdapter resolving every advertised model and preparing its call without reading a credential or opening a stream. Live check against the gateway: balance read (account and per-key), one answer from each of the three models over its own protocol, a rotation rehearsal where an invalid key was disabled and the next attempt answered with the real key, and the host adapter classifying a rejected key as AUTH.
validation.0.2.0-rc.2: Declared in the accepted range; checked against the bundled 0.2.0-rc.2 host packages, not yet in a live boot on this line. Present and used: llm.registerAdapter (fiber-scoped, duplicates refused), llm.registerConfigurableProviders, credential records (credentials-local keeps records in memory, updated on modifyRecord and by a file watcher), connection.rpc.handle, client slots, web.registerSearchProvider with web.searchProviders, loader.entries(), profileContext.patchPath, hmr.runExclusive (refuses nested transactions), and the SettingsForms service: settings.update(rowId, patch) for volatile Config fields, settings.configure, and loader/volatile-update. settings.installSection does NOT exist on this line (an earlier note said it did), so the host overrides (apiHost/statusHost, not volatile) are read-only here while the volatile web search preference is writable.
validation.0.2.1-rc.2: The development host since 2026-10-17: devDependencies pin the packages DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 ships (dsh-* 0.2.1-rc.2, cordis 4.0.5, schemastery 3.18.5, pi-ai 1.1.0), and the client and connection tests also run on 0.2.0-rc.2 through the host-v020 fixture. Before the switch the whole suite also passed against the packages extracted from the desktop app's app.asar. What changed for this plugin: PiAiAdapter.listModels resolves the key first and lists nothing on MISSING_CREDENTIAL; pi-ai 1.x Models folds systemPrompt and tools into a leading system message (toolsAdded) before the provider sees a request; dsh-tools runs PTC programs on ptcRuntime with workingDirectory; Connection admission asks browser auth for authenticateApi; credential-record changes refresh the browser's model catalog. Through the real host adapter, request bodies matched the pi-ai 0.85 baseline for 9 of 10 models (deepseek-flash's tool loses strict: false) and only SDK version headers differ. Not yet checked live or in a running DSH.
